title: Stock market crashes: Sensex tumbles 900 points, Nifty50 trades below 23,000
content: Dalal Street opened the week with a significant decline as the BSE Sensex dropped by more than 500 points. This downturn was driven by investor apprehension over climbing crude oil prices and heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Concerns about India's import bill and inflation loom large amid ongoing foreign selling.

title: Bill Gates Foundation to shut down in 2045: Why some Americans reject its $400m ‘gift’
content: The Bill Gates Foundation is making a bold move by committing $1 billion to ensure equitable AI development for education and healthcare. Of this, $400 million is dedicated to creating AI-driven tutoring systems that tailor learning experiences. This investment arrives amidst rising discussions about digital tools' effectiveness and privacy issues, with New York City already enacting a one-year pause on generative AI in schools.

title: ‘Joined SP?’: Ravi Kishan’s reply after BJP councillor flags waterlogging in Gorakhpur
content: A telephonic conversation between BJP councillor Vishwajit Tripathi and Gorakhpur MP Ravi Kishan has gained attention online. The exchange focused on waterlogging issues during recent heavy rainfall in the city, which has not been seen in two decades. Tripathi expressed concerns regarding ineffective irrigation regulators while seeking intervention from Ravi Kishan. The MP responded by assuring him that he was monitoring the situation and prioritizing public grievances.

title: Louisiana neighbors' fight over 70-foot strip ends with $15K, dead cow stunt
content: In a prolonged conflict stemming from years of camaraderie, two families in Louisiana found themselves locked in a bitter legal battle regarding their property lines. The Colvins asserted ownership over a disputed 70-foot timberland strip, triggering rising tensions. Ultimately, the court sided with the Joneses, affirming the original boundary marked by an aged fence while ordering the Colvins to halt disruptive actions and compensate for damages.

title: Banks call off strike: Why 3-day protest has been deferred by unions
content: This means that all banks across the country will continue to function as usual for the strike period that had been announced September 28-30. This also assumes significance since it's the time for half yearly closing.

title: Parked BMW on highway catches fire; consumer court orders insurer to pay Rs 70 lakh
content: Maharashtra state consumer commission ruled that United India Insurance must compensate a BMW owner after a claim rejection. The car was destroyed by fire following a late-night tyre puncture, leading to the owner seeking compensation. The commission determined that the owner's actions constituted reasonable precautions under the circumstances. The insurer's refusal was deemed a deficiency in service without sufficient justification.

title: $45M SF mansion linked to Ellison sells to investor after year of secrecy
content: Private equity mogul Chuck Esserman has made headlines by purchasing a lavish mansion in San Francisco for $45 million, making it the most expensive home sale in the city for 2025. Formerly owned by Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison, who bought it for just $3.9 million 37 years ago, the estate boasts stunning renovations and breathtaking views of the Golden Gate Bridge, reflecting its rich legacy.

title: Ex-elite runner turned nun raises $2.6M in Chicago Marathon for families
content: Sister Stephanie Baliga once dreamed of becoming an elite runner before finding her calling as a nun. She has since used the Chicago Marathon to raise more than $2.6 million for Mission of Our Lady of the Angels, helping feed families in need. Now, she continues running and fundraising through Team OLA.

title: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt
content: Beginning September 2026, USCIS mandates that Green Card applicants prove financial self-sufficiency to address public charge inadmissibility. This applies mainly to those pursuing family or employment-based applications, though exemptions exist for humanitarian categories such as refugees and trafficking survivors. The Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is essential but doesn't alone assure application approval. In cases of inadmissibility on public charge terms, Public Charge Bonds are an available recourse.

title: Kids need boundaries over freedom to build self-control: Psychology
content: Guiding children towards self-regulation requires parents to create clear and consistent boundaries throughout their growth. This means offering structure while also granting children the freedom to make choices. Studies indicate that the perfect blend of emotional support and steady expectations nurtures vital executive function skills. As children develop, boundaries can evolve, promoting their ability to control behaviors independently.

title: Netanyahu secretly visited UAE, met Emirati leader in Abu Dhabi: Israeli official
content: Netanyahu has rejected the report and threatened legal action against the newspaper. The issue has become politically sensitive as Netanyahu faces a difficult reelection campaign, with opposition figures accusing him of responsibility for security failures before the October 7 attack. A UAE source previously told Reuters that security issues are discussed with other countries through the "relevant entities".

title: Israel minister Ben-Gvir threatens to execute jailed Hamas figure
content: Itamar Ben-Gvir confronted Hamas operative Hassan Salameh in an Israeli prison, where Salameh is serving time for his involvement in lethal attacks. In a dramatic moment he described as closure, Ben-Gvir expressed his wish for Salameh to face execution. This incident underlines Ben-Gvir’s hardline approach to security regarding Palestinian prisoners, especially following recent legislation pushing for the death penalty for terrorists in military courts.

title: Toll soars to 81 as UP is lashed by 775% excess rainfall in 48 hours
content: In a mere 48 hours, torrential rainfall hit Uttar Pradesh, causing devastating consequences that claimed 81 lives and injured 62. The districts of Sitapur, Lakhimpur Kheri, and Bahraich faced the brunt of the disasters. Current rescue operations are focused on evaluating the extensive destruction of property and crops, while officials are mobilizing to offer support to those affected.

title: At 21°C, Delhi records its lowest minimum temperature in Sept in 18 years
content: Delhi experienced its lowest minimum temperature in 18 years, reaching 21 degrees Celsius, which is three notches below normal. The India Meteorological Department reported that heavy rain and storms in surrounding states contributed to the cool weather. Various locations in Delhi also recorded significantly low temperatures, with Ridge at 16.8 degrees Celsius. While the maximum temperature at Safdarjung was recorded at 30.6 degrees Celsius, it remained four notches below normal.

title: UP double murder: Retired Army man, 1st wife found dead in pool of blood
content: In a tragic event, retired Army veteran Shamsuddin and his wife Saddo Begum were discovered murdered in their residence, the police alerted by neighbors. Their bodies were located amidst a pool of blood, prompting forensic experts and a dog squad to join the inquiry. With the motive still unknown, multiple investigation teams are being formed.

title: Judge orders revival of $7B Solar for All program, says EPA overstepped
content: A Rhode Island federal judge has ordered the revival of the $7 billion Solar for All program after the Trump administration’s EPA canceled it in August 2025. Judge Mary S. McElroy ruled the agency overstepped its authority in terminating the Biden-era initiative, which aimed to expand solar access for low-income households nationwide.

title: 14-year-old Georgia student scores perfect 1600 on SAT
content: At just 14 years old, Ashrit Talluri from Georgia has achieved remarkable success, scoring a flawless 1600 on the SAT exam. Having earned 14½ high school credits in middle school, he is now taking college-level courses as a ninth grader at Innovation Academy. With five months of meticulous preparation behind him, Ashrit dreams of becoming a neurosurgeon, eager to delve into projects that combine cutting-edge technology with healthcare.

title: Blind at 8, auto driver's son cracks UPSC with AIR 109
content: Ajay R Raj faced the heartbreaking challenge of losing most of his sight early in life, compounded by financial struggles within his family. Yet, a library became his refuge, igniting his passion for literature. With relentless dedication, he excelled academically and chased his dream, eventually gaining admission to St. Stephen's College in Delhi. His relentless pursuit through several attempts at the UPSC exam showcased his resilience.

title: 'Crushed man's head with stones': How murder accused evaded arrest for 24 years
content: A man named Firoj has been arrested after evading capture for 24 years. He was accused of murdering Kalaam Ansari due to a family vendetta. The incident occurred in February 2002 when Ansari's decomposed body was found in a DDA forest. Investigation revealed that Ansari had moved to Delhi for work with Firoj, who later committed the crime. The case highlights the challenges faced in resolving long-standing criminal investigations.

title: Connor McDavid, Lauren Kyle support kids through cancer care and youth sports
content: Connor McDavid continues his support for the Ben Stelter Foundation, helping families affected by childhood cancer. In January 2026, he attended a fundraiser at Allendale School, highlighting community efforts and the foundation's purpose. Meanwhile, Lauren Kyle serves on the Edmonton Oilers Community Foundation board, promoting youth sport accessibility through initiatives. Their charitable work addresses different issues, yet both focus on benefiting children and families.

title: LeBron James opens up on raising his three children with Savannah James
content: LeBron James, the NBA legend, has reflected on being a father to his children and teaching them about life.

title: Seven months into Hormuz shutdown: Oil remains elevated as Trump rejects Iran proposal
content: On Monday, oil prices surged, driven by escalating tensions in the Middle East following Iran's recent peace proposal. U.S. President Trump's dismissal of the proposal has contributed to market volatility. Both Brent crude and U.S. West Texas Intermediate saw price increases, although worries over diesel exports continue to shape market sentiment.

title: ‘Rape-suicide’ rumour, arson, exams deferred: Key developments on LPU protests
content: Following unsettling rumors of a student's alleged rape and suicide, Lovely Professional University witnessed violent protests. Officials quickly denied these claims, labeling them as false fabrications. In response, police launched an investigation, registering an FIR based on students' outcry. For safety reasons, classes were suspended for ten days, and mid-term exams were postponed. Students were advised to either return home or remain in their hostels until calm is restored.

title: Abhishek's 30-ball ton hid the number that should really worry T20 bowlers
content: Abhishek Sharma's 30-ball T20I hundred against Afghanistan was spectacular, but the bigger story lies in the numbers around it. The India opener is striking at 194.55 while averaging 33.18, combining extraordinary aggression with consistency. His powerplay dominance, six-hitting, record-breaking numbers and the costly downside of his approach reveal how his game has evolved.

title: US Northeast battered by nor’easter as tidal surges flood homes, streets
content: A fierce nor’easter has recently swept through the Northeast United States, leading to extensive coastal flooding and widespread power outages. Tragically, a New York City Housing Authority employee lost their life due to a fallen tree. More than 100,000 residents found themselves without electricity, and certain areas recorded unprecedented rainfall and high tides.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo expands his portfolio with another major investment
content: Cristiano Ronaldo, the football legend, has remained focused on expanding his investment portfolio after adding a Spanish club to it.

title: 'He is playing with freedom': Shubman Gill on Virat Kohli's new approach
content: India captain Shubman Gill believes the best way to get the most out of Virat Kohli is to simply let the star batter be himself. Kohli smashed an unbeaten 139 off 88 balls as India beat West Indies by eight wickets in the first ODI at the Greenfield International Stadium on Sunday. Gill also scored 110 as the two shared a 151-run partnership.

title: Vucic steps down as Serbia’s president, eyes prime minister’s post in October election
content: aleksandar Vucic resigned on sunday, ending his second term early . he said he would hand over his duties to parliament speaker Ana Brnabic . the president is constitutionally barred from seeking a third presidential term .

title: Despite rainfall deficit, kharif acreage above 5-year average
content: overall acreage of kharif (summer-sown) crops in the country declined by just over 1% this year compared with last year . the dip was expected due to deficient monsoon rainfall this year, but the sowing season still ended up recording higher than the 'normal' crop .

title: 'Use lowest effective dose of Nsaids': Fresh advisory on kidney risks of painkiller abuse
content: health minister warns against misuse of painkillers, antibiotics over kidney disease risk . non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Nsaids) and antibiotics should be used only when clinically indicated, at appropriate dose and duration and under medical supervision .

title: LPU protests: Over 2,000 police deployed after stone-pelting, vehicles set ablaze
content: students clashed with police and set vehicles on fire, in Phagwara . police deployed more than 2,000 personnel at Lovely Professional university . senior officers said the situation had been brought under control . the force will remain deployed on campus through the night to maintain security .

title: Balakot to Sindoor, India gave befitting reply: PM Modi on Pakistan terror
content: modi's stern message came in his 'Mann ki Baat' broadcast as India marks 10th anniversary of surgical strikes on terror hideouts in Pakistan on sept 28-29, 2016 . his govt has made it clear with its actions that terrorists will be given a befitting response for their sinister designs against India .

title: 2,000 cops deployed, classes suspended for 10 days: LPU protests spiral into violence
content: students vandalised property and blocked NH-44 during protests . students clashed with police, damaged and set fire to vehicles and pelted stones at security personnel . heavy police deployment made on the campus, while students have started leaving for their homes .

title: Boeing flags glitch that could disengage autopilot on 737 MAX; India has 100 such jets
content: a software issue could disengage the B737 MAX autopilot during certain go-arounds when pilots change their planned altitude and flight path . India has about 100 of these aircraft between Air India Express and Akasa . aviation insiders say this is not a safety scare .
